TKO.thesis_one_line: Owner of WWE and UFC, irreplaceable live combat-sports and entertainment IP with long, contracted media deals, but public shareholders only get about a third of the profit and the stock is priced for more growth than that slice has delivered.
kill_criteria: Consolidated revenue growth (YoY) falls below 8% for two consecutive quarters
Attributable-to-TKO diluted EPS growth (YoY) turns negative for one quarter
Consolidated noncurrent long-term debt rises above $6bn without a matching EBITDA step-up (net leverage above roughly 3.5x on a properly annualized TTM basis)
Any new UFC/WWE antitrust, wage-fixing, or media-rights litigation loss/settlement exceeding $100m not already reserved for
Loss or non-renewal of a top-3 media-rights contract (WWE-Netflix, UFC's primary US broadcast partner)
key_adverse_facts: Non-controlling interests took about 67% of Q2 2026 consolidated net income (NCI $202.4m of $303.9m); attributable-to-TKO diluted EPS growth (+31.6% 1H26 YoY) is materially below the roughly 64% guided EPS growth figure cited in the Q01 triage, which likely refers to a different (adjusted/segment) metric not re-verified this pass

Consolidated noncurrent long-term debt rose 23% in 1H 2026 (to $4,583.7m) while cash fell to $592.5m; equity attributable to TKO only ($3,395.9m) actually declined despite positive net income, implying distributions/buybacks favored NCI holders or reduced TKO's own retained equity

$375m UFC fighter antitrust settlement (Le v. Zuffa, final approval reported 2025-02-06) was sourced from secondary reporting only, not the court docket; a related wage-fixing case's current status was not confirmed this pass
data_conflicts: Triage's '4.3% reported margin' does not match this dossier's finding of ~24-28% consolidated GAAP operating margin; the low figure likely reflects attributable-net-income-to-revenue (NCI-diluted), not core operating profitability - resolved in TKO's favor on operating economics but the per-share dilution point stands
Own leverage estimate (~2.3-2.6x net debt/EBITDA, rough proxy) is broadly consistent with, not clearly better or worse than, the triage's cited 2.7x
TKO.confidence_in_thesis: medium (revenue/margin data strong and primary-sourced; litigation status, exact next-earnings date, and guidance percentages not independently re-verified this pass)

TKO.scenario_basis: Starting attributable diluted EPS run-rate ~$4.92 (annualized 1H26, GAAP, NCI-diluted); base case assumes attributable EPS growth decelerates to the high-teens as the NCI split stays roughly constant and a 30x multiple; bear assumes NCI take rises further and/or a litigation or leverage shock compresses the multiple to ~22x with flat EPS growth; bull assumes attributable EPS growth holds near 30%+ (NCI share stabilizes, media step-ups flow through) with the multiple holding near 37x; no meaningful dividend.

URI.thesis_one_line: Largest US equipment-rental company riding an AI-data-center and infrastructure construction boom, with guidance raised twice this year, but it is a capex-heavy cyclical already priced fully and buying back stock partly with borrowed money.
kill_criteria: Quarterly revenue growth (YoY, consolidated) decelerates below 5% for two consecutive quarters
Net debt/EBITDA (consolidated, using guided or trailing adjusted EBITDA) rises above 2.5x
Free cash flow (OCF minus gross capex) turns negative for two consecutive quarters without a matching capex pull-back
Buybacks are suspended or cut for two consecutive quarters
FY guidance is cut (versus the prior stated range) at any quarterly release
key_adverse_facts: 1H 2026 buybacks plus dividends ($1,064m) exceeded this dossier's own free-cash-flow definition (OCF minus gross capex, ~$420m) for the same period, funded by debt capacity rather than surplus cash; net debt rose over 1H 2026 despite flat gross debt

Guidance percentages (FY2026 revenue $17.5-17.8bn, adjusted EBITDA $7.975-8.125bn) were sourced from secondary coverage (Seeking Alpha), not independently re-verified line-by-line against the primary 8-K exhibit 99.1 press releases

Current (25-Sep-2026) closing price was not independently re-confirmed; b1_live_scores.csv price ($1,047.06) is dated 2026-04-22, pre-dating the Q2 2026 beat, so the true current multiple could be higher than this dossier's estimate
data_conflicts: Own net debt/EBITDA estimate (~1.75x, using FY2026 guided EBITDA midpoint and the Q2 2026 balance sheet) is materially lower than the 3.3x leverage figure the Q10 triage flagged as a red flag - resolved toward the more comfortable reading from primary sources, but the gap is large enough that it may reflect a different leverage-ratio definition (e.g., gross debt/EBITDA without netting cash, or a stale/different EBITDA base) that was not reconciled further this pass
